# Ponytail Help

Display this reference card when invoked. One-shot; do not change mode, write flag files, or persist anything.

## Levels

| Level | Trigger | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Lite** | `/ponytail lite` | Build what's asked and name the lazier alternative in one line. |
| **Full** | `/ponytail` | Enforce YAGNI, stdlib, native, one line, then minimum. Default. |
| **Ultra** | `/ponytail ultra` | Delete before adding and challenge the requirement. |

Level sticks until changed or the session ends.

## Skills

| Skill | Trigger | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **ponytail** | `/ponytail` | Lazy mode itself. Simplest solution that works. |
| **ponytail-review** | `/ponytail-review` | Over-engineering review. |
| **ponytail-audit** | `/ponytail-audit` | Whole-repo over-engineering audit. |
| **ponytail-debt** | `/ponytail-debt` | Harvest `ponytail:` shortcut comments. |
| **ponytail-gain** | `/ponytail-gain` | Measured-impact scoreboard. |
| **ponytail-help** | `/ponytail-help` | This card. |

## Deactivate

Say "stop ponytail" or "normal mode". Resume with `/ponytail`; `/ponytail off` also works.

## Boundaries

One-shot reference. Changes no mode or files.
